create_uploadinfo_from_path: create UploadInfo from a file path to get SHA256 hash, size, and sample bytes for LFS upload
create_uploadinfo_from_bytes: create UploadInfo from raw bytes to get SHA256 hash, size, and sample for LFS upload
run_post_lfs_batch_info: run post_lfs_batch_info to request LFS upload instructions from the Hugging Face Hub API
run_lfs_upload: run lfs_upload to upload a file to Hugging Face Hub using single-part or multi-part LFS protocol
review_uploadinfo_class: review the UploadInfo dataclass that holds SHA256 hash, size, and sample bytes for LFS blob determination
